# Metin Survivors — Complete Reference (`llms-full.txt`)

> Metin Survivors is a free-to-play, zero-install 3D browser action roguelite (survivors-like) built for WebGL2. Play solo or team up with up to 4 players in real-time online co-op to survive relentless enemy waves, shatter corrupted Metin stones, defeat 20 bosses across 4 zones, and unlock permanent upgrades.

- **Canonical URL:** https://metin-survivors.com/
- **Summary file:** https://metin-survivors.com/llms.txt
- **Sitemap:** https://metin-survivors.com/sitemap.xml
- **Supported Languages:** Turkish (`tr`), English (`en`)
- **Pricing:** Free-to-play (no download, no installation)
- **Genre Classification:** Action Roguelite (not strict roguelike — features persistent cross-run meta-progression)

---

## Türkçe Özet

Metin Survivors, tarayıcı üzerinden kurulum gerektirmeden doğrudan oynanabilen ücretsiz bir 3D aksiyon roguelite (survivors-like) hayatta kalma oyunudur.
Oyuncular 5 farklı sınıf ve 10 doktrinden birini seçerek 4 farklı bölgede düşman dalgalarına karşı koyar, haritaya düşen Metin taşlarını kırar ve 20 patrona karşı mücadele eder.
Tek oyunculu modun yanı sıra oda koduyla en fazla 4 kişiye kadar gerçek zamanlı çevrimiçi co-op, bulut kaydı, haftalık/sınıf/co-op skor tabloları ve kalıcı meta-ilerleme (Yetenekler, Cephanelik, Demirci, Koleksiyon, Kodeks) içerir.

---

## Playable Hero Classes & Doctrines (5 Classes, 10 Doctrines)

Each hero class has two specialized doctrines that shape active skills, scaling, and combat identity:

1. **Warrior / Savaşçı**
   - **Sinew (`Kuvvet`):** Heavy melee vanguard focused on close-range cleave, physical burst, and frontline pressure.
   - **Spirit (`Ruh`):** Disciplined sword-aura specialist combining sweeping area strikes with durable defensive tempo.
2. **Ninja**
   - **Silent Edge (`Sessiz Bıçak`):** High-mobility melee assassin specializing in rapid dashes, critical strikes, and close-quarters agility.
   - **Quiver (`Sadak`):** Ranged marksman firing piercing volleys, arrow spreads, and mobile kiting salvos.
3. **Yacha**
   - **Spellsteel (`Büyü Çeliği`):** Hybrid blade-caster weaving enchanted sword arcs with arcane sustain.
   - **Hexcraft (`Lanet Sanatı`):** Dark-magic specialist chaining curses, area-of-effect hex zones, and damage-over-time bursts.
4. **Shaman / Şaman**
   - **Talisman (`Tılsım`):** Elemental caster unleashing talisman barrages, lightning/flame sigils, and battlefield control.
   - **Stormbalm (`Bora Merhemi`):** Support-oriented storm weaver pairing restorative utility and shields with storm pressure — especially valuable in 4-player co-op.
5. **Wolfman**
   - **Redmane (`Kızıl Yele`):** Ferocious melee brawler built around savage claws, bleed pressure, and relentless aggression.
   - **Moonmane (`Ay Yelesi`):** Lunar-attuned feral striker blending agile lunges with spirit-infused area bursts.

---

## World Zones (4 Zones)

1. **Yeonmu Plains (`Yeonmu Ovası`)** — Open frontier lowlands introducing core wave pacing, Metin stone drops, and early bosses.
2. **Suryeon Valley (`Suryeon Vadisi`)** — Rugged valley terrain with denser enemy formations and escalating elite encounters.
3. **Mount Seori (`Seori Dağı`)** — High-altitude frozen peaks with harsher hazards, tougher enemy archetypes, and high-tier boss fights.
4. **Daeryeol (`Daeryeol`)** — Endgame volcanic/corrupted battleground designed to test maximized builds and coordinated co-op parties.

---

## Core Gameplay & Systems

- **Waves, Metin Stones & Corruption:** Enemies arrive in escalating waves while burning Metin stones crash into the arena. Breaking Metin stones triggers risk-reward encounters, loot drops, and progression spikes.
- **114 Skills & Build Crafting:** Level up during runs to draft, upgrade, and synergize class skills, doctrine abilities, and passives.
- **20 Boss Encounters:** Multi-phase boss fights with telegraphed attacks and zone milestones.
- **Combat Modes:** Supports both manual aiming/casting (mouse/keyboard) and optional auto-combat toggles for relaxed or mobile play.
- **Roguelite Meta-Progression:**
  - **Talents (`Yetenekler`):** Permanent stat and utility upgrades unlocked across runs.
  - **Armory (`Cephanelik`):** Unlockable and equippable gear loadouts.
  - **Blacksmith (`Demirci`):** Equipment enhancement and upgrading.
  - **Collection (`Koleksiyon`):** Long-term completion milestones and bonuses.
  - **Codex (`Kodeks`):** In-game encyclopedia tracking enemies, bosses, items, and discoveries.
- **Online Co-op (1–4 Players):** Create or join a room with a short room code; real-time synchronized simulation over WebSockets with party revive/team play and dedicated co-op leaderboards.
- **Cloud Save & Leaderboards:** Instant local save with optional cloud sync and verified global leaderboards (solo, co-op, weekly, and per-class rankings).

---

## Controls & Platform Support

- **Desktop:** `WASD` or Arrow keys to move, mouse aim + click to attack/cast, hotkeys for active skills and dash/dodge, optional Auto-Attack / Auto-Skill toggle.
- **Mobile & Touch:** On-screen virtual joystick and responsive portrait/landscape HUD.
- **Gamepad / Controller:** Supported for movement, menus, and combat.
- **Technical Stack:** 3D WebGL2 rendering (Three.js) served via Cloudflare global CDN, with real-time co-op rooms and cloud saves powered by Cloudflare Workers, Durable Objects, D1, and R2.

---

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Is Metin Survivors free to play?**
Yes. It is completely free to play in your browser with no download or installation.

**Is Metin Survivors a roguelite or a roguelike?**
It is an action roguelite (survivors-like). Individual runs start fresh with randomized skill drafts, while permanent meta-progression carries over between runs via Talents, Armory, Blacksmith, Collection, and Codex.

**Can I play Metin Survivors with friends?**
Yes. Up to 4 players can play together in real-time online co-op using a shareable room code.

**Which browsers and devices work best?**
Any modern Chromium, Firefox, or Safari browser with WebGL2 enabled on Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, or Android. It can also be installed as a Progressive Web App (PWA).
